newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse ends little changed in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse ends little changed in thin trading.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share Index began the week little changed on Monday in thin trading, its market report showed.
The Index rose 0.03 points to 354.04 points from Friday's 354.01.

Bids outpaced offers for the second time this year totalling 2,474,470 to 1,098,120 but only 68,170 shares changed hands. On Friday, bids of 2,441,770 compared to offers 1,889,520 and 1,216,970 shares changed hands.
Home Finance Company (+1 cedi to 140 cedis) and Pioneer Tobacco Company (+1 to 136) were the only stocks to rise. Agro-processor and trading company UNILEVER (-1 to 749) was the only declining issue.
